response.overview: If you need to add baggage to an Oman Air  flight, USA+1866-829-1309 or  +44-204-586-5394(UK) you can generally add checked bags after booking through your reservation. USA+1866-829-1309 or  +44-204-586-5394(UK) Adding baggage before arriving at the airport can make your check-in process easier and lets you review the applicable baggage charge in advance.  Whether you want to add one checked bag, USA+1866-829-1309 or  +44-204-586-5394(UK) prepay for luggage, or check the cost of an additional bag, the process starts with reviewing your Oman Air reservation and current baggage allowance.  How Do I Add Baggage to My Oman Air Reservation?  To add baggage to an Oman Air reservation, USA+1866-829-1309 or  +44-204-586-5394(UK) open your existing booking and look for the baggage or manage-trip option. USA+1866-829-1309 or  +44-204-586-5394(UK) Select the number of checked bags you need and review the displayed fee before completing payment.
